title: Rockstar Mods Real Life Vehicles to Look Like GTA 6 Cars in Miami
description: IGN reports that Rockstar has kicked off a wild marketing push for GTA 6, featuring modded real-life cars cruising around the streets of Miami.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Kicks Off Wild GTA 6 Marketing Push in Miami

As the anticipation for *Grand Theft Auto VI* continues to reach unprecedented heights across the global gaming community, Rockstar Games appears to be ramping up its promotional efforts. According to a recent report by IGN, the studio's wild marketing push for *GTA 6* is officially well underway, featuring a brilliant and immersive real-world activation.

### Bringing GTA 6 Cars to the Streets of Miami

In what can only be described as a dream come true for car enthusiasts and gamers alike, the latest marketing stunt involves heavily modding real-life vehicles to look precisely like the iconic cars featured in *GTA 6*. Instead of just keeping these custom builds hidden away for exclusive media events, Rockstar took things a step further by actually driving these game-inspired vehicles around the real-world streets of Miami—the very metropolis that serves as the direct inspiration for the game's setting.

Seeing these custom rides cruising through Miami provides a surreal crossover between the virtual universe and reality. Pedestrians and fans who spotted the vehicles on the road quickly took to social media, further amplifying the buzz and proving once again that Rockstar knows how to command the public's attention without saying a single word.

### A History of Bold Marketing

Rockstar has never been shy about executing unconventional, high-impact marketing campaigns for its flagship franchises. By bringing fictional in-game aesthetics into the physical world, the studio continues to build massive momentum and excitement as the community awaits further official updates regarding the game.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar's decision to mod real-life cars and drive them through Miami is a masterclass in experiential marketing. It grounds the fictional world of *GTA 6* in reality while celebrating the real-life culture that inspired it. It's a fun, engaging stunt that successfully keeps the community hooked and talking.
